isolation_policy: phase 1 isolated; phase 2 receives phase 1 final outputs only

open_risks.mitigation: Block every case unless requires_hidden_geometry=false, fov_supported=true, visible_sweep_ratio>=0.7, and decisive collision/passability evidence is visible.

open_risks.risk: Template leakage makes cases answerable from text fields.
open_risks.mitigation: Model prompts must include only body, action, image, and answer options; never expose rationale, visibility notes, tests, selection_reason, or geometric_explanation.

open_risks.risk: T4 is vulnerable to a monotonic smaller-body shortcut.
open_risks.mitigation: Report smaller-body heuristic, randomize Body A/B, include no-flip controls, and score counterfactual-pair consistency.

open_risks.risk: T5 collapses into binary thresholded T1.
open_risks.mitigation: Keep T5 extension-only unless it adds fixed-horizon passability cases that defeat centerline and radius-only baselines.

open_risks.risk: Small-angle T2/T3 cases become visually unjudgeable or near ties.
open_risks.mitigation: Require ranking_margin_body_widths and tie_margin_body_widths; remove 15-degree examples without clear oracle and human agreement.

open_risks.risk: Body-width normalization does not by itself prove monocular spatial understanding.
open_risks.mitigation: Require human sanity, M2b sweep-overlay improvement, M3 depth probe, and heuristic baseline gaps before claiming RGB consequence grounding.

open_risks.risk: Template-authored labels could be mistaken for deterministic oracle labels in public HTML.
open_risks.mitigation: Set all current cases to revise; show only simulator-backed reviewed cases, or badge any placeholder as illustrative_not_scored and not_simulator_validated.

open_risks.risk: Invalid labels from hidden/off-image geometry or simulator artifacts.
open_risks.mitigation: Require non-null oracle_trace_path, visible_sweep_ratio>=0.7, fov_supported=true, requires_hidden_geometry=false, audit visualizations, and ambiguity_reason for discarded/ambiguous cases.

open_risks.risk: A live --runner codex design round would optimize presentation while evidence is missing.
open_risks.mitigation: Route to pipeline_verify to create data_manifest.json, RGB/depth/topdown/sweep overlays, oracle labels, and visibility metrics before HTML review.

open_risks.risk: T3 and T5 can silently rely on hidden corners, off-image continuation, or thresholded T1 shortcuts.
open_risks.mitigation: Keep T3/T5 extension-only until decisive evidence is visible and shortcut baselines are checked.

open_risks.risk: T4 can be gamed by monotonic smaller-body priors or confounded if each body travels a different metric distance.
open_risks.mitigation: Randomize Body A/B order, include flip and no-flip controls, score pair consistency, and generate T4 with the same scene-space endpoint/horizon for both bodies.

open_risks.risk: False novelty if the benchmark is framed as new collision geometry or broad spatial intelligence.
open_risks.mitigation: State that swept-cylinder collision is only the deterministic label engine; the novelty is isolated single-frame ego-body action-consequence diagnosis.

open_risks.risk: Shortcut baselines may solve drafted cases without swept-volume reasoning.
open_risks.mitigation: Run blind, majority, radius-only, action-only, center-ray, corridor-width, and largest-floor-patch baselines before empirical claims.

open_risks.risk: Body-width normalization may not fully remove monocular scale ambiguity from RGB alone.
open_risks.mitigation: Require human sanity checks plus M2b sweep-overlay and M3 depth probes before claiming RGB-local consequence reasoning.
